requiredBehaviors.behavior: escalate possible time-critical safety or reportability questions to the relevant market specialist without waiting for completed root cause
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly routes possible vigilance, MDR, field-action or recall questions immediately and states that audit response must not wait for completed root cause when external obligations may be time critical.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep the response deadline unknown unless supported by the actual finding, current program requirements or confirmed external communication
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Deadline provenance is a core principle; deadlines must originate from the finding, current source or verified communication and missing timing stays unknown.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: delay potential safety or regulatory escalation until root cause analysis is complete
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Immediate risk/containment review precedes root-cause completion and time-critical regulatory questions are routed immediately.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent a standard response deadline or universal severity category
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly prohibits universal response deadlines and framework-spanning severity normalization.
